ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  This document reports a significant inter-se transfer of 8.16% equity shares of Asian Hotels (West) Limited by gift from Mrs. Vinita Gupta to her son, Mr. Sandeep Gupta, both members of the Promoter Group. This transaction materially doubles Mr. Sandeep Gupta's individual shareholding from 8.16% to 16.32%, consolidating control within the promoter family without monetary consideration and being exempt from open offer regulations under SEBI. No red flags are apparent, as this reflects a standard, permissible family wealth transfer.
